locations.name: Locación de pozo (aérea)
locations.description: WELL SITE, aerial view at dawn: a drilling rig mast and a pumpjack next to a wellhead with red valves on a pale white-grey gravel pad, a curving gravel access road, a row of white modular trailers, barbed-wire fence with weathered wooden posts, dry Patagonian steppe with low shrubs, flat mesetas on the horizon, soft pink-and-blue dawn sky.

locations.name: Escalera de la plataforma de workover
locations.description: WORKOVER PLATFORM STAIRS: steep yellow steel staircase with yellow handrails rising to a blue-and-yellow workover platform over a wellhead with red valves and blue machinery, stacked steel tubing on wooden sleepers beside it, bright white-grey gravel, a pumpjack in the distance, dry Patagonian steppe. Two lighting versions: midday under a deep blue sky, and golden-hour sunset with warm backlight.

locations.name: Piso de la plataforma de workover
locations.description: WORKOVER PLATFORM DECK, high angle from the top of the stairs: steel grating deck with yellow handrails and a stair opening, a wellhead with red valves and pressure gauges, worn blue-painted drawworks machinery, the Patagonian steppe and flat mesetas below with distant pumpjacks, warm low sun.

locations.name: Vestuario
locations.description: LOCKER ROOM inside a prefab module: tall grey steel lockers with louvered doors (one open), a long wooden bench, white hard hats hanging on wall hooks, light wood-grain laminate walls, a fluorescent tube light, a small window with daylight, a wall-mounted first-aid box, dark ribbed rubber floor.

locations.name: Rincón de seguridad (oficina contenedor)
locations.description: SAFETY CORNER inside a container office: light wood-grain laminate walls, a red first-aid cabinet and a green emergency sign, a white hard hat and red leather gloves on wall hooks, hand-sanitizer dispensers, a red fire extinguisher on the wall, two grey steel lockers, a small table with a mate gourd and papers, blue chairs, a whiteboard, a window with daylight onto the gravel yard and white trailers.

locations.name: Pasillo del módulo
locations.description: MODULE CORRIDOR: long narrow corridor with pale grey and wood-grain laminate wall panels, a row of blank dark flat screens mounted on the wall, fluorescent ceiling lights, glossy light floor, an open door at the far end with bright daylight.

locations.name: Campamento (aérea)
locations.description: CAMP, aerial view: rows of white modular trailers along a gravel road, a large white prefab building, small storage containers and piled pipes, dry Patagonian steppe, flat mesetas on the horizon with a drilling rig and pumpjacks in the distance, partly cloudy sky, soft daylight.

locations.name: Módulo exterior
locations.description: MODULE EXTERIOR: a single white trailer module with dark green trim, small windows and two doors with metal steps, a wooden bench, a red wheeled fire extinguisher and a green hose by the wall, white-grey gravel ground, a wire fence, Patagonian steppe at golden hour with long shadows.

locations.name: Cabina de descanso
locations.description: REST CABIN: small bedroom inside a module, a single bed with a grey wool blanket and a white pillow, a wooden nightstand with a small lamp, a navy work coverall and a white hard hat hanging on wall hooks, work boots on the floor, a small grey steel locker, wood-grain laminate walls, a window with a dark roller blind, warm low lamp light.

locations.name: Comedor del campamento
locations.description: CAMP CANTEEN: long wooden tables with rows of blue and red plastic chairs, light wood-grain laminate walls, fluorescent tube lights, a whiteboard, wide windows onto the gravel yard and white trailers, a stainless-steel serving counter and kitchen at the back, a red fire extinguisher. Versions: angled daytime view, centered daytime view, and centered night view with dark windows.

locations.name: Mesa del comedor (cenital)
locations.description: CANTEEN TABLE, top-down overhead view: long wooden tables set with white plates, cutlery and glasses, blue and red plastic chairs on both sides, grey concrete floor.

locations.name: Patio de ripio y flota
locations.description: YARD with FLEET: bright white-grey gravel (ripio) surface, Patagonian steppe behind, distant flat mesetas, barbed-wire fence with weathered white wooden posts, deep blue sky. White heavy trucks, tank trucks with cylindrical white aluminum tanks, and a white utility truck with red and navy swoosh stripes; door decal with the Clear logo and a fleet number; amber roof beacons; red-diamond flammable-liquid placard with a UN number on tankers. No third-party brand names or logos; trucks stay generic.
